2558-5315-6277--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5315-6277--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

4691-5165-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
4691-5165-6922.description:
Donate control of Vilis to an opponent using Coveted Falcon
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Ob Nixilis triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

1870-3789-4873-5087.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-3789-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
1870-3789-4873-5087.description:
Use The Blackstaff of Waterdeep to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

3129-4826-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4222-6006-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

348-792-1152-3191-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-792-1152-3191-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Totentanz triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1993-3861-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1993-3861-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

1496-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1987-4125-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4125-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-4125-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4125-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-955-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-955-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3197-7399-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-7399-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-5220-6505-7452.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2178-2511-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

907-1308-1558-2638-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1308-1558-2638-4231.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-2829-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-2829-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-698-7302.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
141-698-7302.description:
Activate Will by tapping it
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost reduced by Will, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Will.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Will.
Repeat from step 4.

1879-2366-3512-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1879-2366-3512-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-6155-6529.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6155-6529.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

539-4693-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3944-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

628-2366-2773-6931.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
628-2366-2773-6931.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters, Tourach's Chant and Warstorm Surge trigger.
Resolve the Tourach's Chant trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dryad Arbor.
Dryad Arbor dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Dryad Arbor enters, Tourach's Chant and Warstorm Surge trigger.
Resolve the Tourach's Chant trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing damage to Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 4.

997-4215-5630-6872.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

339-677-1753-2921.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3330-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-5641-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

803-1238-2351-2511-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

890-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
890-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Palladium Myr does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Palladium Myr
890-5149-5200.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Palladium Myr.
Repeat.
890-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

751-3168-5613-5929.easyPrerequisites:
"Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator
"Samurai" chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
751-3168-5613-5929.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {0}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-3090-5096-5361.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-3090-5096-5361.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

3858-5675.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 15.
3858-5675.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Loxodon Lifechanter by paying {5}{W}, causing it to get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is your life total.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Loxodon Lifechanter, then causing you to gain 10 life and win the game.

250-3946-4935.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability and The Gitrog Monster's first ability trigger.
Resolve The Gitrog Monster trigger, sacrificing Glacial Chasm.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, choosing not to pay and doing nothing as Glacial Chasm is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

185-2501-3098-4872-4914.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
185-2501-3098-4872-4914.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater, targeting yourself.
Time Warp's casualty ability and Skywise Teachings trigger.
Resolve the Time Warp trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Skywise Teachings trigger, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a 2/2 Djinn Monk creature token.
Resolve both Time Warps, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Djinn Monk, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Skywise Teachings trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Time Warp.
Resolve the Skywise Teachings trigger, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a 2/2 Djinn Monk creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Time Warp and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Djinn Monk, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Skywise Teachings trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Time Warp.
Resolve the Skywise Teachings trigger, creating a 2/2 Djinn Monk creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Time Warp and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

618-2741-3957-4613.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-2741-3957-4613.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Famished Paladin token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Famished Paladin you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

261-262-859.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
261-262-859.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Suture Priest's first ability four times.
Resolve the first Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2034-2043-2648.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Triniform that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform, adding {C}{C}.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Golems, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.

1837-4398.description:
Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Arcane Laboratory prevents players from casting more than one spell each turn, players cannot cast the spell permitted by Eye of the Storm, or any other spell that turn.

1150-2018-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Melira's Keepers.
When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

539-1339-2232-3652-3848.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
539-1339-2232-3652-3848.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, triggering Omnath's second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control and drawing a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-4191-4504.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adding one mana of any color.
Endless Cockroaches dies, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Endless Cockroaches by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1785-2178-2577.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
1785-2178-2577.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {B}.
Gravecrawler dies, triggering Soldevi Adnate, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

659-2440-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Krenko.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
659-2440-5200.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin tokens.
The Goblins enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes at least two times, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
